messages:
alex: Quick triage: embed-worker leaking ~120MB over 30m under steady traffic. Patch ready (allocator free path). Suggest the 00:00-00:15 nightshift mini-window for a hotfix with an expedited canary.

ria: Good catch. Patch image: sha256:def456 built 2026-03-23T22:05:00Z. I can do the rollout. Need ops signoff + product_owner for expedited.

nate: Ops can monitor. Proposed rollback triggers: mem-growth >150MB over baseline for 3m OR error-rate spike >0.2% sustained 2m. Any other abort conditions?

alex: Also abort if p95 latency >500ms vs baseline or healthcheck failures x2. Keep canary small: us-central1 3% for 3m, then 20% for 3m, then full.

product_owner: @deploy-bot can you create expedited request? Customer impact low but worth a fast turn.

deploy-bot: @ria submitted expedited-approval for hotfix (rollout window 00:00 UTC). Required approvals: ops_oncall, product_owner. Reply `approve` or react :white_check_mark: to approve.

ops_oncall: approve  I've reviewed heap profiles and smoke tests. Will be on watch.

product_owner: approve  ok from product, customer comms unnecessary for this patch.

deploy-bot: Approvals: ops_oncall, product_owner. Scheduling canary to start at 00:00:30 UTC. Canary plan: us-central1 3m@3% -> 3m@20% -> promote. Monitoring: mem, error-rate, p95.

ria: Starting canary: `deploybot start --image=sha256:def456 --target=us-central1 --percent=3 --canary-id=6177777777` \nlogs: tail /var/log/deploy/6177777777.log

deploy-bot: Canary started. Healthcheck probe interval 30s. First probe OK.

ria: Canary at 20% now, 3m window. No mem rise yet. Heap profiles uploaded: https://go.redwood/heap/6177777777

nate: Observability note: enabled mem flamegraphs and pprof. Setting alert threshold to mem delta >150MB.

ria: Promoting to 100% in 60s if stable.

deploy-bot: Promotion command queued: `deploybot promote --id=6177777777 --to=100 --strategy=linear`\nProgress: 20% -> 100% over 70s.

deploy-bot: SUCCESS: rollout completed at 00:06:15 UTC. Post-deploy checks passed. No SLI breaches detected.

alex: Great. Follow-ups: add one-line note to release notes, schedule 30m post-deploy review tomorrow to double-check leak traces.

product_owner: Thanks team. Marking as expedited -> closed. :tada:

ria: If rollback needed use: \n```
deploybot rollback --id=6177777777 --to=previous
```
I have the old image pinned.

nate: I'll keep monitoring for 45m then hand back to regular oncall. If any regressions, call out immediately.

alex: Closing thread. Hotfix live, monitoring until 00:45 UTC. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
